title: Is there a way to hide the search results when clicking on a search result?
body:
I currently want the following behavior:
- When you click on a search result, it hides the result and ideally clears the input field
- When you type in the search field and then lose focus or click outside the search field or search results list, it hides the results list

Currently I'm just using `onBlur` to get the desired result, but unfortunately I had to change a lot of my handlers to `onMouseDown` since `onBlur` fires before `onClick`. Also when using the `InfiniteHits` widget, clicking on `Load More` automatically closes my results list and doesn't fire due to the `onBlur`.

I know you have a `ClearAll` widget, but it's a separate button and it would be nice to have access to a `clearField` method or something to manually trigger that when I want based on custom behavior.

Let me know if there is a way to take care of the above though.

Thanks!

Ted

comments.body:
Hi @tedlin182, I will ask you the same thing than for your previous question, can you add a little gif showing the behavior you currently get and what is wrong with it? Can you also add a snippet of code to understand the element you are using?

To clear the query you have several options:
* if the `searchState` of `<InstantSearch/>` is externalized you can modify the `searchState` by resetting the key `query` to an empty string.
* You can use the connectSearchBox connector to build a custom component which will have the responsability to clear the query (by calling the refine function with an empty string).

Hi @mthuret 

Yeah I currently am just passing down a custom `clearSearchField` method from my parent search component down to the results components and triggering that `onClick` which just sets `query: ''`.

I wasn't sure if there was a less manual way of doing this, but for now this seems to work.

Thanks
Alright, that's good to hear. I'll close this issue, don't hesitate to reopen it if something goes wrong.
